svg.text: Four SFP+ cages. A module always answers at 0x50, so a PCA9546A gives each cage its own I2C bus.
The mux master SDA/SCL is the same I2C bus as the TPS23881. Downstream pull-ups are next to each cage.
SFP+ 1 host pinout SFF-8431 10GBASE-R from the switch SerDes
TX_DIS, FAULT, ABS, LOS, RS0 and RS1 also land on SoC pins of the same name.
SFP+ 2 host pinout SFF-8431 10GBASE-R from the switch SerDes
TX_DIS, FAULT, ABS, LOS, RS0 and RS1 also land on SoC pins of the same name.
SFP+ 3 host pinout SFF-8431 10GBASE-R from the switch SerDes
TX_DIS, FAULT, ABS, LOS, RS0 and RS1 also land on SoC pins of the same name.
SFP+ 4 host pinout SFF-8431 10GBASE-R from the switch SerDes
TX_DIS, FAULT, ABS, LOS, RS0 and RS1 also land on SoC pins of the same name.
PCA9546A I2C mux. Confirm the TSSOP-16 pin order against NXP Fig. 1 before layout.
A2:A0 = GND, so the 7-bit address is 0x70. Channels 0 to 3 are SFP 1 to 4.
